Bedrock under 100 cm on 24.5 ac of Pigeonroost. Budget rock excavation for septic, water line and footings.
Under an acre of gentle ground carries a workable NRCS septic rating (0.0 ac). Plan on an alternative system and get a soil scientist out before an offer.
0.5 of 30.1 acres are in a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area (A, X). Post-Helene, treat mapped floodplain as unbuildable and plan the driveway around it.
